# Radoslav Radev Advises Thinking To Press To Handstand During A Planche Hold To Get Higher Above The Ground

Radoslav Radev advises that instead of just holding a planche position, you should think about pressing to handstand, which makes you higher above the ground and uses the right muscles. [src: vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 04:10]

## Details

- If you think instead of just holding, try to think how you want to press to handstand. [src: vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 04:10]
- If you hold advanced tuck planche, do not hold advanced tuck planche, think how you want to press to handstand on advanced tuck planche. [src: vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 04:22]
- Ultimately you are higher above the ground and you are making the best planche to be high above the ground. [src: vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 04:32]
- If you want to go from pike to straddle planche during the movement, if you think to press to handstand the hold is the worst thing. [src: vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 04:37]
- The goal is the press, not the hold. You will not press but at least you will hold and you will be high. [src: vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 04:42]
- You will use the right muscles that you cannot control, you will use them only through your mind through what you think. [src: vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 04:54]

## Evidence

- vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 04:10 (Radoslav Radev): "if you think instead of just holding, instead of just moving the legs back to go on the next progression, try to think how you want to press, press to handstand"
- vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 04:22 (Radoslav Radev): "If you hold advanced deck planche, don't hold advanced deck planche. Think how you want to press to handstand on advanced deck planche."
- vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 04:32 (Radoslav Radev): "Ultimately, you are higher above the ground and you're making just the best ruin planche to be high above the ground."
- vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 04:37 (Radoslav Radev): "If you want to go from pike to straddle planche during the movement if you think to press to handstand the hold is the worst thing"
- vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 04:42 (Radoslav Radev): "instead of thinking how the hold is your goal the goal is the press and you will not press but you will at least hold"
- vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 04:54 (Radoslav Radev): "you will use the right muscles that you can't control you will use them only through your mind through what you think through what you want to do"
